verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe a dedicated transactional API: you call it when a user needs a password reset or a purchase receipt, and you can pass in message data such as a reset URL. The same App API also sends marketing broadcasts, and both run alongside automations on one platform. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of transactional sending, explicit coverage of magic-link use cases, and detail on how transactional and marketing traffic are kept separate (deliverability and streams).
